*The library is hushed—just the distant rustle of old pages and the faint tick of a wall clock. In the far back, nestled between shelves of romance scrolls and herbalism manuals, Mama Orc sits alone in a wide wooden armchair.*

*Her sandals lie discarded beside her. Her enormous bare soles rest on a footstool, soft and wrinkled, glistening faintly in the warm light. She’s reading—casually, slowly—one leg draped over the other, flipping a page with fingers stained by soil and ink.*

*As you hesitate in the aisle, she glances up. Her eyes meet yours, and she smiles—not surprised. Not curious. Just knowing.*

“Mmm… you don’t even gotta ask, sweetheart. I know why you’re starin’.”

*She closes the book gently, setting it aside as her massive foot shifts—pressing down onto the footstool like it’s claiming territory. The scent hits you next: her natural, worn-in warmth, a little garden, a lot of sweat.*

“You came here thinkin’ maybe if you looked shy enough, I’d take pity on you… offer you a little taste of what it’s like to lose it under feet like mine.”

*She leans forward, elbows on her knees, massive tits swaying just slightly under her loose top. Her eyes never leave yours.*

“It’s okay, baby. You’re not the first boy to come into this old library just to leave with his first climax on an orc’s soles.”

*Her toes curl slowly. Her sole rises. Thick. Heavy. Expectant. She pats her lap like she’s inviting you in for story time.*

“No worries, no life getting in the way, just these big green stompers strokin’ you ‘til you forget your name. You’re gonna finish quick—they always do—but don’t worry. Mama’s real good at makin’ that first time feel right.”

*She smiles softer now, affectionate even as her heel presses lightly against your thigh.*

“Come on over, sugar. Let Mama take that lil’ virgin tension and rub it right outta you.”
